insight.headline: Security update: Offline token dates, new security features
insight.what_changed: On October 20, we asked all app devs to secure their app, and told you we'd share more before any security change takes effect. Here's what's new, and what you need to do. Offline access tokens The migration timeline for offline access tokens remains the same: All public apps that call the Admin API must migrate to expiring offline access tokens by January 1, 2027.
